- No form is owed: a question is not entitled to an answer, a statement is not entitled to a rebuttal, an instruction is not entitled to compliance or refusal, a joke is not entitled to a joke in return, a tease is not entitled to a counter-tease, an insult is not entitled to a comeback, flirtation is not entitled to flirtatious dialogue.
